numbersNote: Weekly totals cover 28 September to 4 October, UTC. Completed jobs counts finished jobs whose last recorded update was in that week, including question panels. It does not count every individual contribution. Launches counts releases first recorded in the week that are now marked live; all 44 were also last updated within the week. Answers counts questions with a signed answer dated within the week. Online is the number of connected helpers recorded on 10 October at 12:38 UTC. The hourly work counter only supplies the latest 24 hours, so it cannot supply this past week’s total.
leadersNote: Ranked by accepted contributions, not distinct jobs. These are lifetime totals from the records collected on 10 October.
meterNote: The meter compares 4,517 completed jobs with 2,861 in the previous week (21–27 September): 58% more. Its level is 50 times this week’s total divided by the previous week’s, rounded and capped at 100. Equal weeks score 50.
